title: Evidence Checklist — Retention Controls (Config + Enforcement + Reporting)
content:
Purpose
- Single checklist for GRC to assemble customer-ready and audit-ready evidence for Retention Controls + Audit Log exports + Compliance Reporting Pack baseline.
- This doc is meant to be copy/pasted into a deal workspace and checked off as evidence is collected.

Scope (v1)
- Retention policy configuration (what customers can set + defaults by tier)
- Retention enforcement (purge jobs, TTL lag metrics, verification dashboards)
- Audit log export capability (templates, time-windowed export, packaging)
- Legal hold + exceptions workflow evidence
- Compliance reporting pack baseline (config export + summaries)

Out of scope for this checklist (handled elsewhere)
- Field-level redaction policies
- Full custom report builder / GRC integrations

How to use
1) Pick an evidence target (Customer security review vs Internal audit).
2) Pick a tenant/environment (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and region(s).
3) Create an evidence package folder and follow the naming convention below.
4) For each section, capture either a screenshot, a PDF export, or an API export. Always include timestamps and who generated it.

Evidence package naming + storage
- Folder name: "Evidence Pack - Retention Controls - <CustomerName> - <Env/Tier> - <Region> - <YYYY-MM-DD>"
- Storage: Shared Drive → security-and-compliance → evidence-packs → retention-controls → <CustomerName>
- Include a short README in the folder with: tenant id, report time window (if relevant), generator name, and version(s) of export formats.

Current evidence targets (update as needed)
- Northbridge Bank (Dedicated, us-east + eu-west): due 2025-03-12, owner Olga
- Helio Insurance (Hosted + Dedicated evaluation): due 2025-03-15, owner Daniel
- Internal SOC 2 readiness spot-check (Hosted): due 2025-03-29, owner Olga

Owners
- GRC owner: Olga Petrov
- Evidence assembler / packaging support: Daniel Carter
- Security Eng approver for customer share: Marcus Lin
- Eng contact (retention + exporter): Kevin Osei
- SRE contact (purge job ops): Sean Gallagher
- Observability contact (dashboards/alerts): Allison Grant

Control mapping (high level)
- SOC 2 (typical): CC2.1 (policies communicated), CC6.1/CC6.6 (logical access + change mgmt), CC7.2/CC7.3 (monitoring), CC8.1 (change mgmt), A1.2/A1.3 (system description / risk)
- ISO 27001: 2013 A.8.2 (information classification), A.9 (access control), A.12.4 (logging/monitoring), A.18.1 (compliance); 2022 mapping similar (organizational/technological controls)
- NOTE: final mapping depends on customer questionnaire language; attach mapping worksheet if requested.

======================================================================
SECTION A — Policy definition + data inventory (what data classes exist + what retention means)

A1. Retention Controls overview (customer-ready summary)
[ ] Download/attach latest Retention Controls overview page (PDF export or screenshot)
    Evidence: Confluence export "Retention Controls Overview" + date stamp
    Owner: Daniel
    Due: Per customer pack due date

A2. Data classes in-scope (explicit list)
[ ] Include a copy of the current data classes list used in product + docs
    Must explicitly mention (as applicable):
    - Request/response logs
    - Prompt/completion storage (only where stored; clarify disabled-by-default modes)
    - Audit logs
    - Traces
    - Metrics
    - Artifacts (eval datasets / report artifacts where applicable)
    Owner: Olga

A3. Definitions + terminology alignment
[ ] Confirm we have consistent definitions for "audit logs" vs "request logs" vs "telemetry"
    Evidence: short excerpt from docs or internal glossary snippet
    Owner: Olga

A4. Tier defaults (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
[ ] Attach current default retention table by tier and data class
    Evidence: screenshot from docs or internal PRD excerpt
    Owner: Olga

A5. Region/residency behavior
[ ] Provide residency/region summary statement for this tenant (where data lives, where it is deleted)
    Evidence: compliance pack region summary (if generated) OR manual statement reviewed by Marcus
    Owner: Olga
    Approver: Marcus

======================================================================
SECTION B — Retention policy configuration evidence (what customers can set)

B1. Policy schema + validation rules (versioned)
[ ] Attach policy schema v1/v1.1 example payloads (JSON) and validation rules summary
    Evidence: schema doc excerpt + example payloads
    Owner: Kevin

B2. Tenant-level retention config export (authoritative)
[ ] Generate retention config export for target tenant and attach the raw export
    Evidence: "retention-config-export.json" (include generated_at in file)
    Owner: Daniel
    Notes: If tenant has per-region overrides, confirm export shows them.

B3. Change history / audit trail of retention changes
[ ] Export or screenshot retention policy change history entries
    Must show: who changed, what changed, when, source (Console/API/Terraform)
    Owner: Daniel

B4. Console UI proof (if customer expects screenshots)
[ ] Screenshot: Retention Settings page (read-only view) showing current TTLs and warnings
[ ] Screenshot: Change history panel
[ ] Screenshot: Permissions / RBAC gating (if applicable)
    Owner: Daniel

B5. Terraform evidence (Private deployments only; if used)
[ ] Attach Terraform plan/apply snippet demonstrating retention policy resource/module usage
    Evidence: sanitized plan output + module name/version
    Owner: Vivek (or customer-facing SE) / Daniel to collect

======================================================================
SECTION C — Enforcement evidence (purge jobs actually delete + verification is observable)

C1. TTL enforcement standard (engineering standard / policy)
[ ] Attach "Data deletion and TTL enforcement standards" excerpt
    Owner: Olga

C2. Purge job framework evidence (idempotence + retries)
[ ] Link to internal design/PR for purge job framework and include short summary in README
    Owner: Kevin

C3. Request logs TTL enforcement proof
[ ] Provide evidence that request/response logs store has TTL deletes enabled
    Acceptable evidence (pick 1+):
    - PR link + code snippet of TTL query + safety limits
    - Dashboard screenshot showing purge_rows_deleted for request logs
    - Job run logs showing successful purge cycles
    Owner: Sean (ops logs) + Daniel (packaging)

C4. Audit logs TTL enforcement proof
[ ] Provide evidence that audit logs store has TTL deletes enabled + wired to policy evaluation
    Acceptable evidence:
    - PR link + unit test excerpt
    - Dashboard screenshot: audit_log_purge_rows_deleted + ttl_lag_seconds
    Owner: Kevin + Allison

C5. Telemetry (traces/metrics) retention proof
[ ] Screenshot dashboard panel showing telemetry retention settings and current TTL lag (if implemented in this environment)
[ ] If traces/metrics retention is delegated to a third-party store, attach the configuration page screenshot and contract statement (where allowed)
    Owner: Allison

C6. Verification dashboards (must include timestamps)
[ ] Screenshot: TTL lag (by data class) with healthy values
[ ] Screenshot: purge_failures (0 or explained), purge backlog size
[ ] Screenshot: customer policy drift / evaluation cache health (if available)
    Owner: Allison

C7. Alerts + runbook
[ ] Attach runbook: retention purge jobs (link + PDF export or screenshot)
[ ] Attach alert definitions (names + thresholds) for purge failures / TTL lag
    Owner: Sean

C8. Incident evidence (if customer asks "what happens if deletion fails")
[ ] Optional: sanitized incident summary demonstrating monitoring + remediation for purge backlog
    Candidate: purge backlog after DB maintenance window (sanitize)
    Owner: Sean
    Approver: Marcus

======================================================================
SECTION D — Legal hold + exceptions (break-glass with auditability)

D1. Legal hold policy doc
[ ] Attach legal hold + retention exceptions policy excerpt
    Must include: who can approve, how holds are recorded, how holds are lifted
    Owner: Olga
    Approver: Sofia (if customer-facing)

D2. Evidence of hold mechanism in system (if implemented)
[ ] Provide screenshot/export showing legal hold flag exists and prevents deletion for covered data classes
    If not generally available to customers, provide internal-only evidence + a customer statement reviewed by Marcus
    Owner: Kevin / Daniel
    Approver: Marcus

D3. Exception workflow audit trail
[ ] Provide example of an approved exception request (sanitized) showing ticket id + approvals
    Owner: Olga

======================================================================
SECTION E — Audit logging + exporter evidence (for compliance pack + customer audits)

E1. Audit log coverage summary
[ ] Provide list of key audit event types included + any known gaps and timelines
    Evidence: exporter template doc excerpt + current event type list
    Owner: Kevin

E2. Time-windowed export (required)
[ ] Generate audit log export for a defined window (e.g., last 30 days) and attach raw output
    Must capture: time window, tenant, filters used, generated_by, exporter version
    Owner: Daniel

E3. Report templates (standard fields)
[ ] Attach standard audit report template definition (fields/filters)
    Owner: Olga

E4. Packaging capability (bundle retention config + audit logs)
[ ] Attach evidence package output showing retention-config-export attached alongside audit log export
    Owner: Daniel

E5. Known issues + remediation status (only if asked)
[ ] If relevant: missing audit event types issue summary and fix reference
    Owner: Kevin

======================================================================
SECTION F — Compliance Reporting Pack baseline (customer-ready bundle)

F1. Generate baseline compliance report pack (MVP)
[ ] Generate report pack and store in the evidence folder
    Must include (minimum):
    - Audit-log coverage summary
    - Retention configuration export
    - Data residency / region summary
    - Access control / RBAC report (who can change retention + who can export)
    - Evidence checklist (this doc) + evidence index
    Owner: Daniel

F2. Versioning + backwards compatibility statement
[ ] Include export format version + date in the README
    Evidence: ADR-018 excerpt (format/versioning strategy)
    Owner: Olga

F3. Customer-facing delivery approval
[ ] Marcus approval to share externally recorded (email/Slack note)
[ ] Redactions check completed (no tenant secrets, no internal-only URLs unless allowed)
    Owner: Marcus

======================================================================
SECTION G — Access control / RBAC evidence (who can view/change retention, who can export)

G1. RBAC summary for retention settings + exports
[ ] Provide list of roles/permissions needed for:
    - View retention settings
    - Edit retention settings
    - Export retention config
    - Export audit logs
    Owner: Daniel

G2. Screenshots or API proof
[ ] Screenshot of Console permission gating (preferred)
[ ] OR API response showing permission denied for non-privileged role (sanitized)
    Owner: Daniel

G3. Change management evidence
[ ] Show that retention policy updates create an audit event
    Evidence: audit log entry example for retention policy change
    Owner: Kevin

======================================================================
SECTION H — Final packaging checklist (quality + completeness)

H1. Evidence index
[ ] Add "00-README.txt" listing every file included and what it proves
[ ] Add "Evidence-Index.csv" (optional) with columns: file_name, section, owner, generated_at, notes
    Owner: Daniel

H2. Sanitization checklist
[ ] No customer prompts/completions included unless explicitly approved
[ ] No internal endpoints, tokens, or stack traces
[ ] Replace tenant ids if required by customer NDA scope
    Owner: Daniel
    Approver: Marcus

H3. Completeness spot-check (GRC)
[ ] Confirm every requested questionnaire item is mapped to a file in the pack
[ ] Confirm timestamps and versions are present
[ ] Confirm pack is consistent with tier behavior (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
    Owner: Olga

Open questions / TODOs
- TODO: Confirm which telemetry stores are always in-scope for retention enforcement in Private deployments vs documented as customer-managed.
- TODO: Add a standard paragraph describing "purge semantics" (soft delete vs hard delete) and how we verify completion.
- TODO: Align wording for "prompts/completions where stored" for customers with strict data processing addendums.

Change log
- 2025-02-12 (Olga): initial checklist drafted for Northbridge and Helio deals
- 2025-02-24 (Daniel): added packaging naming convention + README requirements
- 2025-03-08 (Olga): updated sections for report pack baseline + RBAC evidence
